# serverguard24_contact (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Serverguard24 contact by `id` or `name`. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.

~> **Performance:** The underlying `get_contacts` endpoint ignores the `id` filter and always returns the full account; the provider filters client-side. A 30s cache with mutex-serialization prevents redundant fetches. Remaining cost is local filtering.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "serverguard24_contact" "example" {
  name = "Ops Team"
}

output "contact_email" {
  value = data.serverguard24_contact.example.email
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Contact ID. Either `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Contact display name. Either `id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) Email address for alert notifications.
- `language` (String) Notification language: `en` or `de`.
- `mobile` (String) Mobile phone number for SMS alerts.
- `network` (String) Network push address.
- `standard` (Boolean) Whether this is the default contact.
